headline: President Obama signed an order updating the Manual for Courts-Martial, the rulebook for military criminal trials.
what_it_does: This order makes changes to the Manual for Courts-Martial, which sets the rules and procedures for military trials and punishments. No summary was provided, so the specific changes are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the US armed forces
who_it_affects.how: Service members facing military criminal charges would be tried under the updated rules.
They must follow the amended procedures when handling courts-martial.
